building: Alpha Sigma Phi (Alpha Pi chapter), Purdue
grader: Independent review; candidate fresh-opened and inspected separately from builder

evidence: Purdue ArcGIS FID 763 names Alpha Sigma Phi, gives 951 David Ross Road, and supplies the eight-vertex footprint.
The chapter history and current chapter source independently corroborate the 951 David Ross Road address.
Fresh Blender inspection found 8 GIS and 8 modeled base vertices; symmetric nearest-vertex maximum error is 0.000062 m.
The saved aerial overlay visually shows the GIS polygon tracking the L-shaped roof.
criteria.deduction: 0.1: chapter occupancy and current facade are not independently confirmed by a direct recent target-facing photograph; the identity is strongly supported by official GIS and chapter address sources but not a visual occupancy check.

evidence: The frozen asset root has identity transform (zero translation/rotation, unit scale), with the footprint vertices already in project campus coordinates.
Independent source-to-model vertex comparison is within 0.000062 m, confirming source-derived plan geometry and its orientation.
Fresh-open world bounds are X -1035.7644 to -1004.0955 m, Y 830.2736 to 874.3992 m, Z -0.03 to 10.44 m.
Aerial imagery shows the same L-shaped roof outline and surrounding lot placement.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: 2018 Indiana 3DEP LiDAR target tile was independently documented; median unclassified returns inside the footprint and nearby class-2 ground returns yield a 10.06 m roof-surface proxy.
The aerial image supports a broad, low-slope/flat L-shaped roof plan and the model reproduces that outline.
The saved Blender model has an approximately 10.44 m maximum envelope including roof/parapet details.
criteria.deduction: 0.7: the LiDAR proxy is not a surveyed wall height (no class-6 building points, noisy roof surface and weak plane fit); Purdue GIS reports NUM_LEVELS=1/CountOfFLO=1 while the model uses three window levels. The flat roof is supported in plan but no elevation resolves parapet or roof-wall height.

evidence: The exterior render shows a consistent masonry running-bond material, repeated framed windows, a recessed main entry/canopy, and a parapet along the L-shaped mass.
The 1976/1979 Alpha Pi archives support house use, a social room, dining-room finish, hallway, and trophy case; the cutaway includes these as clearly identified schematic spaces.
A current street-view panorama was reviewed, but trees and neighboring buildings obscure the target and do not establish this facade design.
criteria.deduction: 0.9: target-specific brick tone, three-level window rhythm, exact window spacing, parapet, and entry position are estimates without a usable target-facing elevation; no verified chapter lettering/signage or distinctive exterior detail is represented. Interior room placement is illustrative rather than plan-derived.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh-opened the exact asset SHA-256 in Blender 5.2.3 LTS; expected scene and asset collection exist.
The asset collection contains 870 mesh objects and 12 assigned materials; no materialless meshes or external file-backed images were found.
Stable asset filename, collection, scene, and root object names are preserved. Review camera/sun are outside the asset collection.
Evidence folder includes source snapshots, provenance, LiDAR analysis, aerial overlay, exterior/interior preview renders, and fresh-open validation.
criteria.deduction: 0.1: the saved asset file also contains an unrelated default Cube in a separate empty Scene; it is outside the exported asset collection and does not affect collection linking, but makes the file slightly less clean.

findings: Passes 8/10 at 8.2/10, with explicit uncertainty deducted for the unsupported floor count and target-specific facade details.
Keep the three-level arrangement labeled as an interpretation: LiDAR supports roof envelope, but the GIS floor-count attributes conflict and do not establish stories.

At master integration, coordinator should update stale manifest metadata (currently massing/object_count 1/bounds Z max 7.6 m) to reflect this 870-object detailed asset and actual dimensions; grader did not edit shared files.
If later photographic evidence becomes available, verify the front entry, facade/window rhythm, and chapter signage before increasing the architectural-detail score.
